payload.summary: The extra spending the political groups put to Budget Council on 24 February 2026, all of it "to fund these in-year from the 2026-2027 budget contingency". Part A is £313,000 from the Labour group — fly-tipping and graffiti enforcement, communal-area improvements, community clean-ups and political assistant provision — and the annex says it "will form part of the substantive motion and not as an amendment". Parts B and C are amendments: a £65,000 ward-level community cohesion fund from the Green and Liberal Democrat groups, and from the Green group £45,000 for planting 100 trees at a stated £459 each and £55,000 for river health education, signage and match funding.
